history.summary: Plan r1 is committed (AnsibleSpecs 0b5f8d0). It is cross-cutting, with five phases: the D7 amendment, ArgoCDDeploy metrics plus additionalUrls, PrometheusDeploy standing rules and no-resolve routing for the events, KubeCoderDeploy record-only promote, and GitSyncDeploy prune. attachments/standing-alerts.md defines the standing-alert behaviour, and verification.json maps R1-R5 in 14 criteria. One design call is visible in Not in scope and the attachment: apps Argo CD does not auto-sync (only argocd-prd today) get no standing out-of-sync alert.

Two questions for the operator: P3/P5 put tests into deploy repos' gates, which conflicts with 'deploy repos run no tests' (D61) and pre-empts slice 027's pending promtool ruling; and the standing out-of-sync alert leaves out apps Argo CD does not auto-sync, which Ruling D1 does not. Two advisory notes (P4 tag numbering vs the runbook; no ArgoCDDeploy-before-PrometheusDeploy push order); citations otherwise verified.

Plan r2 is committed as AnsibleSpecs 890ea7e. Under Ruling T1, P3 now proves its change with promtool unit tests and a routing check against the rendered Alertmanager config, and P5 with a busybox script under tests/; both run in the repo's test verb, share one harness with slice 027, and need promtool, which is committed but not yet published. Ruling D1's auto-sync limit is now in P1, the attachment and V01/V07; P4 makes the re-run the recovery and keeps the runbook recipe as a fallback (V10/V11).
